nodes.text: 🇨🇳  An outbreak of a new human metapneumovirus (hMPV) has emerged in China, overwhelming hospitals, the British tabloid Daily Star reported. https://t.co/nYWzvBNQxm

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text:
China's Disease Control and Prevention Agency says that tests of respiratory patients show mostly influenza, human metapneumovirus and rhinovirus.

The study also found that hMPV is spreading more actively among children under 14.
